Subject: Orion AI trial: kickoff & success criteria

Hi Lauren / Samir — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment before kickoff: 

What we heard (success criteria)
- 95% intent recognition on your 5 core support intents across the 10k sample set you shared
- Avg end-to-end 95th percentile latency < 300ms for our planned sandbox load (10 rps)
- Model responses fall within your compliance truncation rules (no PII leakage in outputs)

Proposed timeline
- Kickoff: week of Sep 7 — proposed time below
- Weekly 30-min check-ins (engineering + CS) — Wednesdays
- Final readout: Thu Sep 30 (customer-facing results + handoff)

Owners (Redwood)
- Tessa Morgan: program lead / weekly syncs / customer PM
- Aditya Rao: infra & deployment lead (dedicated pool/traffic shaping)
- Monica Patel: onboarding & acceptance testing / success criteria verification

What we need from Orion by EOD Mon Sep 6
- Confirmation of kickoff time (see options)
- Sample anonymized dataset (if not already uploaded) + schema
- SSO/SP-initiated test account for 2 Redwood engineers (details below)

Proposed kickoff options (PT):
- Thu Sep 9, 10:00–11:00am PT
- Mon Sep 13, 9:00–10:00am PT

Attachments: draft success metrics workbook (orion_poc_success_metrics.xlsx) and our initial SOW (redwood_poc-sow-v1.pdf). I attached both for visibility.

If that all sounds right I’ll lock the kickoff and send calendar invites + the readout agenda.

Thanks — talk soon.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks Tessa — great summary and appreciate the clear asks. Confirming a few items from our side:

- Kickoff: Thu Sep 9, 10:00–11:00am PT works for our team. Please send the invite.
- Readout: Sep 30 is fine, we’d like a 45-min customer-facing slot around 10:30am PT if possible.
- Deliverables: Samir will upload a sanitized subset of the 10k examples to the Drive folder by EOD Mon. He’s also collecting the schema and will confirm column mappings.
- Security: please include our security contact (jennifer.cao@orionai.com) on any threads that include logs or credentials. We will provide an SSO test account; Samir will email details to you directly.

We reviewed the success metrics workbook and have one ask: can you add a simple error-rate column for hallucination checks (we’ll attach a short list of oracle cases)? If you can include that in the metrics sheet prior to kickoff that would help our acceptance test.

Attachments: none from our side for this message — Samir will follow up with dataset link.

Best,
Lauren

Tessa / Monica — quick infra notes ahead of kickoff: 

- We’ll provision a 1-GPU dedicated sandbox (A100 equivalent) for the trial window. I’ll set autoscaling to 2x burst for the first 48 hours post-kickoff and then revert to baseline unless we see traffic patterns that require permanent scale.
- For latency profiling I need a small synthetic load file and a sample request shape (max prompt length, typical user context). Samir: when you upload the sample set please include a small loaddriver script (JMeter/snippet) or we’ll mock one.
- We’ll enable prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts; Monica, can your acceptance plan include a pass that exercises repeated-session behavior?

I’ll prepare a short infra runbook and pre-kickoff checklist and drop it into the shared Drive link before EOD Tue Sep 7.

—Aditya
